text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although Mejiro Dober wasn't able<n>to win the
Triple Tiara, she feels a<n>sense of accomplishment
after<n>running with all her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her supporters,<n>Mejiro Dober
vows not to cry and<n>instead marches on straight
into her<n>next challenge!
